title: Console Wiki tab shows empty when pages exist
description:
## Symptom
The console Wiki tab shows **Wiki Home** and *This directory is empty.* even when `GET /api/wiki/pages` returns markdown paths and files exist under `project/wiki/`.

Related cards referenced by the report: kbs-e77e32 (serve data root / wiki path) and kbs-177741 (empty-state honesty). Those IDs are not on this board; this bug covers both the false-empty listing and honest empty/missing/error states.

## Intent
As a console user, I want the Wiki tab to show existing pages (or open `index.md`) and to distinguish a missing wiki folder, a truly empty wiki, and a failed pages request, so I am not told the directory is empty when it is not.

## Definition of Done
- With `project/wiki/*.md`, the Wiki tab lists those pages or auto-opens `index.md`.
- If the wiki directory is missing, the UI says the wiki folder is missing (not the empty-directory copy).
- If `/api/wiki/pages` fails, a visible error is shown (not a silent empty directory).
- Console Gherkin covers the false-empty and missing-directory cases.
- Python and Rust step definitions stay in parity.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  openWiki[Open Wiki tab] --> fetchPages[GET /api/wiki/pages]
  fetchPages -->|invalid or HTTP error| showError[Show visible load error]
  fetchPages -->|wiki_directory_exists false| showMissing[Show wiki folder is missing]
  fetchPages -->|pages include index.md| openIndex[Open index.md]
  fetchPages -->|pages exist without index| showListing[Show directory listing]
  fetchPages -->|directory exists and pages empty| showEmpty[Show this directory is empty]
```

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text:
Feature: Console wiki workspace

  Scenario: existing wiki pages are listed instead of a false empty directory
    Given the console is open
    And a wiki page "notes.md" exists with content:
      """
      Notes body
      """
    When I switch to the "Wiki" view
    Then the wiki page list should include "notes.md"
    And the wiki empty state should not be visible

  Scenario: wiki home opens index.md when that page exists
    Given the console is open
    And a wiki page "index.md" exists with content:
      """
      Wiki home
      """
    When I switch to the "Wiki" view
    Then the wiki editor path should be "index.md"
    And the wiki empty state should not be visible

  Scenario: missing wiki directory is distinct from an empty wiki
    Given the console is open
    And the console wiki directory is missing
    When I switch to the "Wiki" view
    Then the wiki missing-directory state should be visible
    And the wiki empty state should not be visible

  Scenario: wiki pages request failure shows a visible error
    Given the console is open
    And the console wiki pages request fails
    When I switch to the "Wiki" view
    Then the wiki error banner should contain "wiki pages request failed"
    And the wiki empty state should not be visible

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text:
Live follow-up: opening `/api/wiki/pages` in a tab returns 12 paths, but `fetch('/api/wiki/pages')` from the Wiki tab stays pending. SSE `/api/events` shows `ERR_INCOMPLETE_CHUNKED_ENCODING`; telemetry POST is `ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED`.

Working hypothesis: Vite proxy + long-lived SSE is starving or wedging the HTTP/1.1 connection pool, so the in-page wiki list request never settles. Snapshot/telemetry errors do not call into WikiPanel, but they can block its fetch.

Next: SSE keep-alives, Vite proxy timeouts/cleanup, and a wiki list request timeout so a hung fetch becomes a visible error instead of a false empty directory.

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text:
Live follow-up: `/api/wiki/pages` returns 12 files in a new tab, but in-page `fetch('/api/wiki/pages')` stayed pending. That is HTTP/1.1 slot exhaustion, not an empty wiki.

SSE `/api/events` dying with `ERR_INCOMPLETE_CHUNKED_ENCODING` (and telemetry `ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED`) does not call into WikiPanel, but those long-lived streams occupy Chrome's 6 connections per origin. React also starts the child wiki fetch before parent SSE cleanup.

Fix in progress: close snapshot/realtime streams synchronously when opening Wiki, time out the pages request, split the Vite proxy so only SSE has no timeout, and show a visible error if the request never settles (`@wiki-ui-017`).
